title: Joomla Extension - jreviews.com - Secret configs cached in a web-accessible in JReviews 1.0.0-5.12.0, 6.0.0-6.6.9 -…
description: JReviews, a Joomla extension, caches its full settings table including sensitive data such as the Joomla global configuration secret and third-party API keys in a serialized file located in a web-accessible directory. This file lacks PHP guards and the directory lacks .htaccess protection, allowing unauthenticated users who know the file name to read it. The vulnerability affects versions 1.0.0 through 5.12.0 and 6.0.0 through 6.6.9 of JReviews.
